feedback.title: Add GitHub / Code Portfolio Link
feedback.description: Recruiters expect a link to your public code repositories for SDE roles.
feedback.suggestion: Include GitHub profile (e.g., github.com/username) in the header contact line.

feedback.title: Strong Action Phrasing
feedback.description: Found 10 impactful action verbs across experience bullets.

feedback.title: Missing Quantifiable Metrics
feedback.description: Bullet points list responsibilities rather than measured outcomes.
feedback.suggestion: Add hard metrics like percentage improvements, throughput scale (e.g. 10k users), or time saved.

feedback.title: Missing Essential Software Development Engineer Keywords
feedback.description: Key industry terms missing from your skills section: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, system design.
feedback.suggestion: Add relevant experience or project bullets demonstrating proficiency in data structures & algorithms.

jdMatches.jdText:
Job Description – Telecom NOC Associate Engineer
Job Details
 Job Title: Associate Support Engineer
 Location: Noida
 Salary: ₹3.6 LPA (post successful completion of the probation period)
 Stipend during probation: ₹9,000 per month
 Probation period: 6 – 10 Months
 Service Agreement: 2 years with an exit clause of ₹2,00,000
 Shift: 24x7 rotational shifts
About the Role
Infinite is seeking motivated engineering graduates to join our Telecom Network
Operations Center (NOC) as Interns. The role offers hands-on exposure to Mobile,
Fixed, and Transport network operations, where interns will monitor network health,
analyze alarms, troubleshoot incidents, and support service restoration while learning
telecom technologies and operational processes.
Key Responsibilities
 Monitor Mobile, Fixed, and Transport network alarms using OUA/NMS/OSS
tools.
 Perform first-level incident analysis, ticket creation, tracking, and escalation as
per SLA.
 Troubleshoot telecom network faults and coordinate with domain/inter domain
T2/SMEs and field teams.
 Support service restoration activities and perform basic health checks.
 Monitor incident queues and ensure SLA compliance in a 24x7 environment.
 Prepare shift handovers, reports, and RCA inputs.
 Document troubleshooting steps and update operational knowledge.
 Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Automation, and Customer teams.
Mandatory Skills
 Basic understanding of telecom networking concepts (IP, TCP/IP, OSI, Routing &
Switching). CCNA certification will be plus point.

-- 1 of 2 --

 Basic knowledge of Mobile (2G/3G/4G/5G), Fixed, or Transport networks.
 Familiarity with Python, Linux, networking commands, or scripting is an added
advantage.
 Understanding of NOC operations and alarm monitoring is preferred.
 Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
 Good verbal and written communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering or a related
Electronics discipline.
 2027 graduates with no active backlogs.
 Basic understanding of IP networking, telecom fundamentals, and MS Office.
 Customer-focused mindset with a willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced
support environment.
 Willingness to work in 24x7 rotational shifts (Base location- Noida) and relocate
to any Infinite office location based on business requirements.
Key Competencies
 Customer service orientation
 Problem-solving and analytical thinking
 Effective communication
 Team collaboration
 Time management
 Adaptability and willingness to learn

-- 2 of 2 --
